title: A Phase 1 Study To Estimate The Effects Of PD 0332334 On Lithium Pharmacokinetics In Healthy Subjects
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate if PD 0332334 affects the pharmacokinetics of lithium by co-administering both drugs to healthy adults.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy males and/or females
* Age from 21 to 55 (inclusive)
* BMI ranges from 18 to 30 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous participation in a PD 332334 study
* Pregnant or nursing females
* Hypersensitivity (allergic) to lithium, Neurontin (gabapentin), or Lyrica (pregabalin)
